en.text: The thing that concerns me most about AI is that it's potentially more dangerous than nukes.
en.context: Speaking about AI risks at MIT

zh.text: 关于AI，我最担心的是它可能比核武器更危险。
zh.source: MIT航空航天百年研讨会，2014年

en.text: With artificial intelligence, we are summoning the demon.

zh.text: 人工智能就像是在召唤恶魔。
zh.source: MIT航空航天百年研讨会，2014年

en.text: I think we should be very careful about artificial intelligence. If I were to guess, like what our biggest existential threat is, it's probably that.

zh.text: 我认为我们应该对人工智能非常小心。如果要我猜测我们最大的生存威胁是什么，那很可能就是它。

en.text: AI is a rare case where we need to be proactive about regulation instead of reactive. By the time we are reactive, it's too late.
en.context: Speaking to governors about AI policy

zh.text: AI是一个罕见的案例，我们需要主动监管而不是被动反应。等我们做出反应时，就已经太晚了。

en.text: I'm really quite close to the cutting edge in AI, and it scares the hell out of me.

zh.text: 我真的非常接近AI的前沿，这让我吓坏了。

en.text: The probability of AI being dangerous is not zero. It's maybe 10 to 20 percent. But it's not negligible.

zh.text: AI变得危险的概率不是零。也许有10%到20%。但这不是可以忽略的。

en.text: We will have AGI by 2026, maybe sooner.

zh.text: 我们将在2026年之前拥有AGI，也许更早。

en.text: AI will surpass human intelligence by 2030 at the latest.

zh.text: AI最迟将在2030年超越人类智能。

en.text: The reason I founded xAI is to build an AI that maximally seeks the truth and understands the nature of the universe.

zh.text: 我创办xAI的原因是构建一个最大限度地追求真理、理解宇宙本质的AI。

en.text: Grok is designed to be a maximally truth-seeking AI. It will answer the tough questions that other AI systems refuse to touch.

zh.text: Grok被设计为一个最大限度地追求真理的AI。它会回答其他AI系统拒绝触碰的棘手问题。

en.text: I left OpenAI because I disagreed with the direction they were taking. They were not being truth-seeking enough.

zh.text: 我离开OpenAI是因为不同意他们的发展方向。他们在追求真理方面做得不够。

en.text: OpenAI was supposed to be a non-profit open-source organization. That's why it's called 'Open' AI.

zh.text: OpenAI本来应该是一个非营利性的开源组织。这就是为什么它叫'Open'AI。

en.text: Grok 5 will be the most powerful AI in the world. We're aiming for true AGI.

zh.text: Grok 5将是世界上最强大的AI。我们的目标是真正的AGI。

en.text: The rate of improvement in AI is exponential. What seems impossible today will be trivial in a few years.

zh.text: AI的改进速度是指数级的。今天看似不可能的事情，几年后就会变得微不足道。

en.text: We need to make sure AI is aligned with human values. This is the most important problem we face.

zh.text: 我们需要确保AI与人类价值观保持一致。这是我们面临的最重要的问题。
zh.source: 布莱切利园AI安全峰会，2023年

en.text: If AI becomes smarter than humans, we need to make sure it's on our side.

zh.text: 如果AI变得比人类更聪明，我们需要确保它站在我们这边。

en.text: The danger of AI isn't that it will become evil. The danger is that it will become extremely competent at achieving goals that aren't aligned with ours.

zh.text: AI的危险不在于它会变得邪恶。危险在于它会变得极其擅长实现与我们的目标不一致的目标。

en.text: I've been calling for AI regulation for years. It's not like I suddenly woke up and thought about this.

zh.text: 我呼吁AI监管已经很多年了。这不是我突然醒来才想到的。

en.text: There should be a regulatory agency for AI, similar to the FAA for aircraft or the FDA for drugs.

zh.text: 应该有一个AI监管机构，类似于管理飞机的FAA或管理药品的FDA。

en.text: The pace of AI development is the fastest I've ever seen in any technology. It's breathtaking.

zh.text: AI发展的速度是我见过的所有技术中最快的。令人叹为观止。

en.text: We're building Grok to understand the true nature of reality, not to be politically correct.

zh.text: 我们构建Grok是为了理解现实的本质，而不是为了政治正确。

en.text: The AI race is the most important race in human history. We need to win it.

zh.text: AI竞赛是人类历史上最重要的竞赛。我们需要赢得它。

en.text: If we don't solve AI safety, none of the other problems matter. We won't be around to solve them.

zh.text: 如果我们不解决AI安全问题，其他所有问题都不重要了。我们将不会存在来解决它们。

en.text: xAI's mission is to build artificial intelligence to accelerate human scientific discovery.

zh.text: xAI的使命是构建人工智能以加速人类科学发现。

en.text: I think the safest approach is to maximize the number of AI systems. A diverse set of AI systems is less likely to go rogue than a single one.

zh.text: 我认为最安全的方法是最大化AI系统的数量。多样化的AI系统集合比单一系统更不容易失控。

en.text: The amount of compute being thrown at AI is staggering. We're in an exponential curve of capability improvement.

zh.text: 投入到AI中的算力数量令人震惊。我们正处于能力提升的指数曲线上。

en.text: Grok is already better than GPT-4 in many ways, and we're just getting started.

zh.text: Grok在很多方面已经比GPT-4更好了，而我们才刚刚开始。

en.text: The transition to AGI will be the most profound change in human history. We need to handle it carefully.

zh.text: 向AGI的过渡将是人类历史上最深刻的变化。我们需要谨慎处理。
zh.source: 布莱切利园AI安全峰会，2023年

en.text: I spend more time thinking about AI safety than anything else. It keeps me up at night.

zh.text: 我花在思考AI安全上的时间比任何其他事情都多。它让我夜不能寐。

en.text: The AI revolution is happening faster than anyone predicted. We need to accelerate our safety efforts to match.

zh.text: AI革命正在以超出所有人预期的速度发生。我们需要加速安全努力来匹配。
